name: cortext
description: Cortext long-term memory: recalls relevant memories into every prompt, stores each finished turn, gives the model memory tools and a /memory pane with the memory levels.

port.title: Daemon port
port.description: Port of the local Cortext daemon (cortext-memory serve).

command.title: Cortext command
command.description: Command used to start the daemon when it is not running.

inject.title: Inject recalled memory
inject.description: Attach recalled memories to each prompt as context the model reads.
